entities.name: Taira no Kiyomori
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Taira no Kiyomori  was a Japanese military leader and kugyō of the late Heian period, who was Daijō-daijin and the de facto ruler of Japan from 1167 until his death. He established the first samurai-dominated administrative government in the history of Japan.
